founder_message: AfriCloud Institute exists to raise African talent. We are an NGO, not a paywall. We believe a young person with drive should not lose a tech career — or a chance to build — because they cannot pay tuition.

Our work is community work: identify promising people, award full scholarships, and mentor them in Cloud, DevOps, AI, Cybersecurity, and related skills until they are job-ready professionals and entrepreneurs who can compete globally and give back at home.

As practitioners, we have seen the gap between theory and what teams actually hire for. AfriCloud was founded to close that gap with live teaching, real projects, and mentors who stay close to the learner.
This is more than a classroom. It is a movement to grow African communities through technology — one scholar, one cohort, one venture at a time.
